name: melodia_echo
purpose: One runnable gate chain for the Melodia integration layer. Nothing is 'done' without a ledger row.

stages.label: Author
stages.note: Proposal must be a spec (json/.qsc) plus the expected gate it claims. Agents are content producers; nothing about a beat is assumed until scored.

stages.label: Spec validation
stages.contract: ids in scope are allowlisted by DA_MelodiaIntegrationConfig or an explicit export, arity matches the 7-verb contract, no duplicate consume-once ids, item:give remains a logging stub

stages.label: Monolith static gates
stages.contract: Monolith must answer; animation state machines are valid, no disconnected pose outputs, runtime ABP matches skeleton

stages.label: Claireon bring-up (PREP — not yet run)
stages.contract: Claireon compiles on UE 5.8, MCP server binds its deterministic worktree port, and tool_search answers. Runs ONLY in the Melodia_ClaireonTest worktree — never the main checkout (python_execute is unsandboxed per Claireon SECURITY.md).

gates.label: Claireon builds on UE 5.8
gates.contract: BS_GodFileEditor target builds with Claireon enabled, 0 errors. A FAILURE here is a valid, reportable outcome — upstream has open bugs for UE 5.7+ builds (issue #6) and bp_compile hangs (issue #7), and no public record of a 5.8 build exists.

gates.label: MCP server binds deterministic port
gates.contract: Saved/Claireon/MCPServer.json exists with a live port + PID. Expected port: 57818 for Melodia_ClaireonTest, 64998 for BS_GodFile (SHA-256 of canonical root folded into 49152-65535).

gates.label: tool_search answers over the live catalog
gates.contract: tool_search returns ranked results from the SQLite FTS5 + embedding index against a running editor. Client-side probe (Tools/test_claireon_toolcalls.py) is NOT this gate — it scores model behaviour with the editor offline.

gates.label: python_execute round-trips to the editor
gates.contract: A claireon.<tool>(...) call executes in-editor and returns a typed result. Must be audit-logged (LogClaireon PythonAuditLog) and read back after every run.

stages.label: Runtime gates
stages.contract: Monolith runtime tools are clean; Melodia.Wiring and campaign evidence are reviewed separately and recorded explicitly

stages.label: Orchestra convergence
stages.contract: The four pillars converge onto the two absolute authority layers (QuillScript, TurnBased JRPG template). One owner per seam. A second owner is a defect. See Docs/ORCHESTRA_CONTRACT_2026-08-20.md for the seam map and Docs/ORCHESTRA_CONVERGENCE_2026-08-20.md for OWNER/DEAD/MERGE verdicts.

gates.label: rhythm owner
gates.contract: Exactly one rhythm path reaches the JRPG damage calculation. NOTE: this is about the execution path, NOT which module a class lives in -- MelodiaRhythmHUDWidget and MelodiaRhythmReactivitySubsystem live in MelodiaCore and are both load-bearing.

gates.label: hud single writer
gates.contract: One writer owns the battle HUD. No widget is written by both stock BP_BattleUI and a Melodia overlay in the same frame. Source consolidation now places Melodia battle widgets under MelodiaUIBridgeSubsystem; closed-editor compile and viewport proof remain required before promotion.

gates.label: wardrobe equip roundtrip
gates.contract: Equip -> save -> process restart -> load -> correct outfit and correct materials, through the UMelodiaWardrobeSubsystem API only.

gates.label: rhythm grade to result
gates.contract: A real-key rhythm grade demonstrably changes a JRPG battle result, and Quill resumes exactly once.

gates.label: music world key
gates.contract: One world object responds to one played phrase. APCGHeroMusicGraphHost::OnPatternCompleted reaches UMelodiaNarrativeSubsystem as a 7-verb notification. Music opens doors; it never enters the combat or damage pipeline.

gates.label: wardrobe gameplay hook
gates.contract: One outfit produces one observable gameplay difference via IMelodiaTraversalCapabilityProvider (Glide/Dash/Swim).

stages.label: Record
stages.contract: every stage appends a dated ledger row; next session reads the ledger, not prose

stages.label: Promote
stages.impl: commit + baseline update + AGENTS.md next-work tick
stages.contract: bp_fingerprints.json / material_catalog.json updated if fingerprints moved; plain git add/commit; LFS batch within collab 50MB / full 512MB (git_safe_push.py); see Docs/LIVEOPS_GIT_SOP_2026-08-11.md

completion_definitions.runtime: Victory/Defeat/Fled/unavailable; each resumes/aborts Quill exactly once
completion_definitions.save_load: Canonical BP_JRPGSaveGame slot across a full process restart
completion_definitions.repeat_consume: Flag+reward restore without duplication; melodia:stat: idempotent per IntentId
completion_definitions.package_launch: Development-packaged build launches outside the editor

agent_contract.producer: an agent or the owner authors a spec + claimed gate
agent_contract.gate: the claimed gate must record a ledger row before it is believed
agent_contract.authority: DA_MelodiaIntegrationConfig allowlist is the live check; there is no relaxed-mode claim in Shipping
